data.long_meaning: The name Barlow is derived from Old English, meaning 'bright or illustrious plowman'. This name is a nod to the agricultural roots and hardworking nature associated with farming and the land. The name Barlow carries the meaning “Bright or Illustrious Plowman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barlow usually hope their child will grow to embody bright or illustrious plowman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
